DEVICE_GUIDE.TITLE: Add device
DEVICE_GUIDE.RECONFIGURE_DESCRIPTION: Put the device in setup or pairing mode, then choose the matching reconfiguration method.
DEVICE_GUIDE.HERO_TITLE: How would you like to add it?
DEVICE_GUIDE.HERO_DESCRIPTION: Power on your device and choose the connection method that matches it.
DEVICE_GUIDE.WIFI_TITLE: Discover and set up a Wi-Fi device
DEVICE_GUIDE.WIFI_DESCRIPTION: Find a nearby device over BLE, then connect it to 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi.
DEVICE_GUIDE.WIFI_META: Bluetooth and Nearby Devices permissions are required
DEVICE_GUIDE.WIFI_PAGE_DESCRIPTION: Discover the device over BLE, then securely send the network information it needs to get online.
DEVICE_GUIDE.WIFI_STEP_DEVICE_TITLE: Put the device in setup mode
DEVICE_GUIDE.WIFI_STEP_DEVICE_DESCRIPTION: Power on or reset the device until its setup indicator begins flashing.
DEVICE_GUIDE.WIFI_STEP_BLUETOOTH_DESCRIPTION: Allow Bluetooth and Nearby Devices access when prompted.
DEVICE_GUIDE.WIFI_STEP_NETWORK_DESCRIPTION: Have the Wi-Fi name and password ready before starting.
DEVICE_GUIDE.WIFI_PAGE_TIP: Keep your phone close to the device throughout provisioning. The connection usually takes less than a minute.
DEVICE_GUIDE.BLE_TITLE: Discover and set up a BLE device
DEVICE_GUIDE.BLE_DESCRIPTION: Scan for a Bluetooth Low Energy device and configure its GATT services.
DEVICE_GUIDE.BLE_META: Put the device in pairing mode first
DEVICE_GUIDE.BLE_PAGE_HEADING: Securely add a nearby BLE device
DEVICE_GUIDE.BLE_PAGE_DESCRIPTION: Discover and securely claim the device, then synchronize its declared controls and current state.
DEVICE_GUIDE.BLE_STEP_DEVICE_TITLE: Put the device in pairing mode
DEVICE_GUIDE.BLE_STEP_DEVICE_DESCRIPTION: Keep the device powered on and make sure it is advertising.
DEVICE_GUIDE.BLE_STEP_PERMISSION_DESCRIPTION: Bluetooth scanning requires the system's Nearby Devices permission.
DEVICE_GUIDE.BLE_STEP_SELECT_DESCRIPTION: The app verifies the device, opens an encrypted session, and synchronizes its Manifest and State.
DEVICE_GUIDE.BLE_PAGE_TIP: If the device does not appear, move closer and restart its pairing mode before scanning again.
DEVICE_GUIDE.BLE_RECOVERY_DESCRIPTION: If setup was interrupted and the device has not been reset, bring your phone nearby to continue using the original setup record. This does not create another device or clear access.
DEVICE_GUIDE.BLE_RECOVERY_LOAD_FAILED: Could not read unfinished setup records. Reopen this page to try again.
DEVICE_GUIDE.BLE_NOT_FOUND: No Blinker BLE device in setup mode was found. Move closer and try again.
DEVICE_GUIDE.BLE_PERMISSION_FAILED: Bluetooth or Nearby Devices access is required. Allow it when prompted and try again.
DEVICE_GUIDE.BLE_ENROLL_FAILED: Secure enrollment did not complete. Check the network and device before retrying.
DEVICE_GUIDE.BLE_DEVICE_RETIRED: The device's previous cloud authorization is no longer active. The old enrollment cannot restore it. Local access has not been confirmed cleared; check the device's removal and reset status first.
DEVICE_GUIDE.BLE_OWNER_INACTIVE: This account cannot enroll devices. Check the signed-in account and its status.
DEVICE_GUIDE.BLE_RESET_REQUIRED: The device is still using its previous enrollment context. Reset device access locally before adding it again. Restarting alone does not clear access.
DEVICE_GUIDE.BLE_READY_DESCRIPTION: The secure session is active and Manifest and State are synchronized.
DEVICE_GUIDE.KEY_METHOD_DESCRIPTION: Create a DeviceKey and paste it into your device code.
DEVICE_GUIDE.KEY_METHOD_META: Best for development boards and existing firmware
DEVICE_GUIDE.KEY_HERO_DESCRIPTION: Create the device, copy its DeviceKey, and paste it into your Blinker sketch.
DEVICE_GUIDE.KEY_DEVICE_NAME_HELP: This name is saved with the new Device V2 identity.
DEVICE_GUIDE.KEY_SECURITY_DESCRIPTION: A device key identifies your device. Do not share it in screenshots, logs, or public code.
DEVICE_GUIDE.KEY_RESULT_DESCRIPTION: Copy this DeviceKey and replace REPLACE_WITH_DEVICE_KEY in your sketch before uploading it.
DEVICE_GUIDE.KEY_COPY_FAILED: Could not copy the DeviceKey. Show it and copy it manually.
DEVICE_GUIDE.KEY_USAGE_TITLE: Use it with the current Blinker Wi-Fi API
DEVICE_GUIDE.KEY_USAGE_DESCRIPTION: Include BlinkerWiFi.h and pass the DeviceKey, Wi-Fi name, password, and your components to Blinker.begin().
DEVICE_GUIDE.KEY_REVEAL_FAILED_TITLE: Device created, but key reveal failed
DEVICE_GUIDE.KEY_REVEAL_FAILED_DESCRIPTION: The device identity from this operation is retained. Retry reveal only; the app will not create another device.
DEVICE_GUIDE.KEY_RETRY_REVEAL_HELP: The retry uses the original logicalDeviceId and never calls create.
DEVICE_GUIDE.KEY_REVEAL_BLOCKED_DESCRIPTION: The server rejected this reveal request. The operation is stopped without creating again or falling back to legacy APIs.
DEVICE_GUIDE.KEY_STEP_UP_BLOCKED_DESCRIPTION: The device key security check is temporarily unavailable. Try again later in device settings. Your device is retained; do not create it again.
DEVICE_GUIDE.KEY_RECENT_AUTH_TITLE: Sign in again to access DeviceKey
DEVICE_GUIDE.KEY_RECENT_AUTH_DESCRIPTION: To protect your device key, sign out and sign in again, then view or refresh the key in this device's settings. Your device is retained; do not create it again.
DEVICE_GUIDE.KEY_CREATE_BLOCKED_TITLE: Device creation could not be confirmed
DEVICE_GUIDE.KEY_CREATE_BLOCKED_DESCRIPTION: No valid creation confirmation was received. Check your device list first. If retrying, keep the original device name. The app will not resubmit automatically.
DEVICE_GUIDE.KEY_DEVICE_LIMIT_DESCRIPTION: Your current device allowance is full, so another device cannot be created. Check your existing device list or ask an administrator to verify the allowance before trying again. The app will not resubmit automatically.
DEVICE_GUIDE.KEY_DEVICE_ENTITLEMENT_TITLE: Device creation entitlement could not be confirmed
DEVICE_GUIDE.KEY_DEVICE_ENTITLEMENT_DESCRIPTION: The server could not confirm device creation entitlement for this account. Try again later, or ask an administrator to verify the account entitlement if this continues. The app will not resubmit automatically.
DEVICE_GUIDE.KEY_CREATE_INVALID_DESCRIPTION: Check the device name before submitting again. If this continues, verify that the app and service versions match. The app will not resubmit automatically.
DEVICE_GUIDE.KEY_CREATE_AUTH_DESCRIPTION: Your current session cannot complete device creation. Sign in again before trying. The app will not resubmit automatically.
DEVICE_GUIDE.KEY_CREATE_DENIED_DESCRIPTION: The server denied creation permission. Ask an administrator to check your account status and permissions. This does not mean your device allowance is full.
DEVICE_GUIDE.KEY_CREATE_ENDPOINT_TITLE: Device creation is unavailable in this service
DEVICE_GUIDE.KEY_CREATE_ENDPOINT_DESCRIPTION: Check the app environment and service version, or ask an administrator to verify the creation endpoint. The app will not resubmit automatically.
DEVICE_GUIDE.KEY_CREATE_CONFLICT_DESCRIPTION: This request conflicts with the current server state. Check your device list before reopening creation. The app will not resubmit automatically.
DEVICE_GUIDE.KEY_CREATE_ACCOUNT_UNAVAILABLE_DESCRIPTI: The account's service status does not allow device creation. Sign in again or ask an administrator to check it. The app will not resubmit automatically.
DEVICE_GUIDE.KEY_CREATE_RATE_LIMITED_DESCRIPTION: Wait before submitting manually again. The app will not resubmit automatically or switch accounts or endpoints.
DEVICE_GUIDE.KEY_CREATE_NETWORK_DESCRIPTION: No confirmation was received; the device may already exist. Check your network and device list. If retrying, keep the original device name. The app will not resubmit automatically.
DEVICE_GUIDE.KEY_CREATE_TIMEOUT_DESCRIPTION: No confirmation was received; the device may already exist. Check your device list first. If retrying, keep the original device name. The app will not resubmit automatically.
DEVICE_GUIDE.KEY_CREATE_PREPARING_DESCRIPTION: The server is still preparing the connection; the device may already exist. Check your device list first. You can retry manually later with the original device name.
DEVICE_GUIDE.KEY_CREATE_SERVICE_DESCRIPTION: No confirmation was received; the device may already exist. Check your device list first. Retry manually later with the original name. The app will not resubmit automatically.
DEVICE_GUIDE.CREATE_FAILED: Device creation failed. Submitting again reuses this idempotent request.
DEVICE_GUIDE.AUTH_EXPIRED: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
DEVICE_GUIDE.OLD_DEVICE_ENTRY_TITLE: Move a Blinker V2 device to the new app
DEVICE_GUIDE.OLD_DEVICE_ENTRY_DESCRIPTION: Migrate data with the phone number and device key from your old account
DEVICE_GUIDE.OLD_DEVICE_HEADING: Bring your device data with you
DEVICE_GUIDE.OLD_DEVICE_DESCRIPTION: Enter the phone number for your Blinker V2 account and the device key to migrate its data.
DEVICE_GUIDE.OLD_DEVICE_PHONE_PLACEHOLDER: Enter the phone number for your old account
DEVICE_GUIDE.OLD_DEVICE_KEY_PLACEHOLDER: Enter the key for the device to migrate
DEVICE_GUIDE.OLD_DEVICE_SECURITY_TITLE: Confirm that you own this device
DEVICE_GUIDE.OLD_DEVICE_SECURITY_DESCRIPTION: The device key is used only to verify this migration. Do not share it with anyone.
DEVICE_GUIDE.OLD_DEVICE_FAILED: Could not migrate the data. Please try again.
DEVICE_GUIDE.OLD_DEVICE_API_PENDING: The migration service is not connected yet. Please try again later.
